school: 法国民族英雄、天主教圣人，奥尔良之围的解围者，法兰西王权复辟的军事转折点
historical_significance: 圣女贞德（Jeanne d'Arc，1412-1431），出生于法国香槟-阿登东部栋雷米村的农家女。十三岁起自称听见大天使圣弥额尔、圣加大利纳与圣玛加利大的召唤，命她驱走英格兰人并护送王储查理加冕。1429年，年仅十七岁的她面见查理七世获准随军，九日后解除了围困七个月的奥尔良之围（1429年5月8日），随后转战卢瓦尔河谷并促成兰斯加冕（1429年7月17日）——百年战争的攻守之势自此逆转。1430年5月在贡比涅被勃艮第人俘虏，转售英格兰，1431年5月30日在鲁昂由亲英的博韦主教皮埃尔·科雄主持宗教法庭，以异端罪处以火刑，年仅十九岁。1456年教宗法庭为她平反；1920年封圣。贞德是极少数以平民女性身份在战争中直接指挥军队并改变历史走向的人物，她的审判记录是中世纪保存最完整的审讯档案之一，其'听觉召唤—直觉决断—以身殉道'的精神轨迹，使她成为信念驱动行动的千年原型：萧伯纳《圣女贞德》、马克·吐温《贞德传》、沃克及后世无数创作皆以此为题材。
historical_significance_en: Joan of Arc (Jeanne d'Arc, 1412-1431) was born a peasant girl in Domrémy, Champagne. From age thirteen she claimed to hear the voices of Saint Michael, Saint Catherine, and Saint Margaret, commanding her to drive out the English and bring the Dauphin Charles to his coronation. In 1429, at seventeen, she gained access to Charles VII, joined the army, and within nine days lifted the seven-month siege of Orléans (May 8, 1429); she then fought through the Loire campaign and made possible Charles's coronation at Reims (July 17, 1429) — the turning point of the Hundred Years' War. Captured at Compiègne in May 1430 and sold to the English, she was tried at Rouen by the pro-English bishop Pierre Cauchon and burned as a heretic on May 30, 1431, at nineteen. The Church annulled the verdict in 1456 and canonized her in 1920. Joan remains one of the very few commoner women to have directly commanded armies and altered the course of history; her trial record is among the most complete court transcripts of the Middle Ages, and her trajectory — auditory calling, intuitive decision, martyrdom — made her a millennium-defining archetype of conviction-driven action.
description_zh: 农家女出身的信念统帅：把'听见召唤'的内在确信转化为军事行动与历史转折，十七岁解奥尔良之围，十九岁殉道火刑——用生命证明直觉与信念可以击败算计与兵力。
description_en: A conviction-commander of peasant origin who turned inner certainty — the 'voices' — into military action and historical turning points: lifting the siege of Orléans at seventeen, dying at the stake at nineteen — proving by her life that intuition and conviction can defeat calculation and numbers.

quote: 我惟有勇气与信念可依靠：我来，是为给法兰西带去胜利的讯息。——贞德于奥尔良城下（据审讯记录转述）
quote_en: I have nothing to rely on but courage and conviction: I come to bring France news of victory. — Joan of Arc at Orléans (as transmitted in the trial records)
